verdict.rationale: SavvyCal documents rule-based ways to steer bookings toward better times rather than the first open slot. It presents ranked availability windows, encourages booking near existing meetings to avoid fragmentation, and combines availability across attendees, including external calendars and recipient overlays. Nothing in the evidence describes AI choosing the time or ongoing re-optimization after booking; the recipient still picks from ranked options. Missing for 10: AI-driven time selection, continuous optimization or automatic rescheduling of booked meetings, optimization scored across every attendee's preferences, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a knowledge worker, AI finds and continuously optimizes the best meeting time across all attendees' calendars, not just the first open slot

citations.quote: Present ranked availability windows to encourage recipients to pick the optimal time (while still remaining flexible).
Encourage people to schedule meetings near other meetings, to prevent calendar fragmentation.
Allow recipients to overlay their calendar on top of yours to easily find mutual availability.
Show combined availability for you and any number of teammates that allow recipients to book a time with your selected group.
Include external calendars when showing team availability.
